device_info.description: Informations sur le périphérique utilisé pour se connecter (chaîne vide acceptée, comme par Core API)

code.description: Authorization code Keycloak appended to the redirect URI after the user signed in (single use, short-lived).

redirect_uri.description: Redirect URI sent in the authorization request, byte for byte: Keycloak refuses the code otherwise.

code_verifier.description: PKCE verifier matching the `code_challenge` of the authorization request. Omit it only if the request carried no challenge.

nonce.description: Nonce sent in the authorization request; the ID token must carry the same value. Omit it only if the request carried no nonce.

device_info.description: Description of the device, stored on the session (empty string accepted, like the password login).

password.description: Mot de passe du nouvel utilisateur

phone_number.description: Numéro de téléphone du nouvel utilisateur

new_password.description: Nouveau mot de passe de l'utilisateur

token.description: Token de changement forcé du mot de passe

phone.description: Numéro de téléphone de l'utilisateur (null si non renseigné)

refresh_token.description: Refresh token retourné par le Core API

post_logout_redirect_uri.description: Where Keycloak sends the browser once the single sign-on session is closed. Must be one of the valid post-logout redirect URIs of the Keycloak client; defaults to KEYCLOAK_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URI.

logout_url.description: Keycloak end-session URL the browser must navigate to so the single sign-on session is closed on every tool of the realm (n8n, ...). Absent when Keycloak is not configured on this instance: the logout is then complete once the cookie is cleared.

post.summary: Signs a user in with Keycloak
post.description: Completes the Keycloak single sign-on (OpenID Connect authorization code flow): forwards the authorization code to Core API (POST /api/v1/auth/keycloak), which redeems it, verifies the ID token and opens a session for the Mairie 360 account with the same verified e-mail. The session is then set exactly like POST /auth/login (httpOnly `accessToken` cookie + `Authorization` header), so every front and BFF keeps working unchanged and the user keeps their roles. The password login stays available during the transition.

200.description: Signed in; the access JWT is in Authorization and in the `accessToken` cookie, the body holds the refresh token.

401.description: Keycloak refused the code (unknown, expired, reused, or redirect_uri / code_verifier mismatch) or the ID token failed verification; restart the sign-in from Keycloak.

403.description: The Keycloak identity has no verified e-mail, or matches no active Mairie 360 account.

502.description: Core API or Keycloak unavailable, or invalid upstream response

503.description: Keycloak sign-in is not configured on this instance; use POST /auth/login instead.

post.description: Valide puis transmet les informations d'inscription au Core API (POST /api/v1/auth/register, route publique).

204.description: Mot de passe changé avec succès

403.description: Token de première connexion inconnu ou expiré

502.description: Core API indisponible ou réponse amont invalide

post.summary: Signs a user out of Mairie 360 and of the single sign-on
post.description: Clears the httpOnly `accessToken` cookie. When Keycloak is configured on the instance (KEYCLOAK_REALM_URL + KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID), the response also carries `logout_url`, the OpenID Connect end-session URL of the realm: the front must send the browser there so Keycloak closes the single sign-on session and, through its front-channel / back-channel logout, the sessions of the other tools of the realm (n8n, ...). Core API keeps no Keycloak token, so the URL carries `client_id` rather than `id_token_hint`: Keycloak asks the user to confirm the logout, then redirects to `post_logout_redirect_uri` (body field, else KEYCLOAK_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URI) if the client allows it.

200.description: Cookie cleared; navigate to `logout_url` when present to close the Keycloak session.

400.description: Invalid payload (`post_logout_redirect_uri` is not a URL)
